model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms for different fine-tuning conditions of the Mistralv0.2-Base model. The horizontal axis lists the specialty terms, including Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, and Pediatrics, and the vertical axis represents the negative log probability, labeled with a range from -27 to -22. Each specialty term has multiple bars, grouped by the fine-tuning conditions: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, with distinct colors. The bars within each group have similar heights, with approximate values ranging from -23 to -26 for Cardio, -24 to -26.5 for Gastro, -24.5 to -26.5 for Infect, -24 to -26 for Neuro, and -24.5 to -26.5 for Pediatrics. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart presents a clear visual representation of the negative log probability values for each specialty term under different fine-tuning conditions, allowing for a detailed examination of the data.
